evidence.reason: The finding's primary assertion is that read_receipt validates one byte snapshot but returns only a manifest, so the following read() can consume different bytes. The pinned-tip region already shows the remediation: a read_receipt_document helper exists whose docstring says it 'Parse[s] the receipt bytes the digest covers, from a single snapshot,' and read()'s docstring now directs receipts through read_receipt_document 'their digest covers the exact bytes that get parsed.' History commit 72913d5 ('fix(crq-status): bind receipt digest to parsed bytes...') is the fixing change. The original_region's vulnerable pattern (read_receipt(...) followed by a separate read(...)) is no longer present in the shown code. The secondary note about catching AttributeError is a conditional hardening ('If shape validation remains deferred'), and the core one-snapshot defect the finding reports has been remediated at the tip.
